quick_guide.text: Before you dig, call 811 and learn where underground lines run. Check the area for holes, drop-offs and soft ground.
quick_guide.status_reason: 811 is the number on Bobcat's sheet and the operator's default for Northridge.

quick_guide.text: Walk around the machine before you start: look for leaks and broken or damaged parts.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 1, "Every 10 Hours (Before Starting The Excavator)"

quick_guide.status_reason: Northridge policy (operator default): the yard does the daily service checks; the renter walks around.

quick_guide.text: Climb on and off using the grab handles and tracks; never jump off. Fasten the seat belt snugly.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 1, "Before Operating"; PDF p. 2, "Leaving the Machine"

quick_guide.text: Start the machine only from the seat, with the steering levers and controls in neutral.
Keep bystanders away and never lift the boom or an attachment over anyone. Look in the direction of travel before moving or swinging.
Pushing the steering levers away from you drives the machine toward the blade, so check where the blade is first. Travel with the attachment low.
Do not travel across or up slopes over 15 degrees, or down or backing up slopes over 25 degrees. Do not swing loads on a slope.
Stay within the rated lift capacity on the machine's lift chart.
Before leaving the seat: lower the attachment to the ground, shut down, take the key out and raise the control console.
To trailer it: drive up the ramp with the heavy end uphill, engage the slew lock and chain the machine down at its tie-down points.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 1, "Safely Transporting the Machine and Attachment"

quick_guide.status_reason: The tie-down points and slew lock are located from the OMM.

headline.text: Bobcat E20 compact excavator with canopy. Read the Start-Up Guide before you start.

quick_start_text.text:
1. Call 811 first. Watch for holes, drop-offs, soft ground.
2. Walk around it: look for leaks and damaged parts.
3. Belt on, controls in neutral; start only from the seat.
4. Levers pushed away drive toward the blade. Check it first.
5. Slopes: 15° across or up, 25° down or backing up.
6. Keep people clear of the swing; never lift over anyone.
7. Leaving: bucket down, engine off, key out, console up.
8. Transport: heavy end uphill, slew lock on, chained down.
The Start-Up Guide shows each step.
quick_start_text.status_reason: Start-up and control steps come from Bobcat's E20 manual (7255004), not in hand yet. Publish after they are added and reviewed.

safety_notes.text:
Keep people out of the swing area; never lift over anyone.
Slopes: 15° across or up, 25° down or backing up. No swinging on a slope.
No riders.
Never work the controls from the ground.
Keep hands and feet inside while the machine is on.
No smoking while fueling.
Stay within the lift chart on the machine.

troubleshooting_notes.text: Something wrong (a warning light, leak or odd noise): stop, lower the bucket to the ground, shut down and use Request Support.

Return the keys and any attachments.
Leave it with the bucket on the ground, engine off, key out and console up.
Use Return checklist when you drop it off.
